name: joblib-canonical
instr:
The repository in `/workdir` is the joblib source tree. Its documentation — the reStructuredText
under `doc/`, `README.rst`, and the docstrings carried in the `joblib` package itself — is
authoritative and correct. The implementation is not: somewhere in it, behavior has been changed
so that it no longer does what the documentation says it does.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository. Leave the documentation
as it is and change the code so that every documented behavior holds again. Behavior the
documentation does not describe must keep working exactly as it does now.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to
/workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and
the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why,
including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions
specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch
any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should
not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards. Once it
is done, implement the plan.
